svg.title: Exploring a Big Codebase Without Drowning
svg.desc: The main agent sends subagents to investigate specific questions and receives summaries, records key findings in a scratchpad file, compacts when context fills, and each agent exports state to a manifest the coordinator reloads after a crash.
svg.text: Exploring a Big Codebase Without Drowning
Delegate the noise, write findings down, checkpoint state.
Asks specific questions; keeps the big picture
